TOURISM SUMMIT OVERVIEW

Summit Theme: “One Destination. One Vision. One Future.”

Summit Theme Introduction – Setting a shared direction for the future of tourism in Puerto Princesa.
Objectives & Expected Outputs – To assess the current tourism landscape, identify key challenges and opportunities, gather stakeholder inputs, and establish priority directions for tourism development.
Two-Day Program Overview – Brief presentation of the key sessions, consultations, discussions, and expected outputs for Day 1 and Day 2.
Guidelines for participant engagement:  
1. Participate actively
2. Ask relevant questions [only]
3. Share practical insights
4. Respect diverse perspectives
QR Code / Question Submission – Participants may submit questions in advance through the QR code for the designated Q&A sessions.
